title: Blueberry Vanilla Scones
excerpt: Enjoy soft, golden homemade scones scented with vanilla and loaded with the natural sweetness of our fresh blueberries. Ideal for tea time or an afternoon snack.
imageAlt: Freshly baked golden scones with fresh blueberries and vanilla, served on a wooden board for afternoon tea.

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup unsalted butter, very cold and cubed

steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C (390°F) and prepare a baking tray with wax paper or a silicone mat.
In a large bowl, mix the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. Add the cold butter and crumble it with your fingers until it has a coarse crumb texture.
In a small bowl, whisk the heavy cream with the egg and vanilla extract until well combined.

Pour the liquid ingredients over the dry ones and mix gently. Fold in the Fresh Pick blueberries, grown in the high mountains of Guasca, using folding motions to keep their natural bloom and juiciness intact.
Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and shape it into a disc 2 cm (3/4 in) thick. Cut the disc into 8 equal triangles.
Put the tray with the scones in the fridge for 15 minutes; this cold rest helps the butter keep a crumbly, flaky texture during baking.
Brush the tops with a little extra heavy cream and bake for 18 to 20 minutes until nicely golden. Let cool slightly before enjoying.
tips: Keeping the butter and the cream very cold is the big secret to scones that are flaky inside and crisp outside.
Take advantage of the fact that Fresh Pick blueberries come without artificial waxes to add them straight to the dough without rinsing them too much or drying them too thoroughly.
If you have leftover baked scones, store them in an airtight container and warm them for 3 minutes in a toaster oven before serving to bring back their freshness.
